key: Hello! Would you like to play Sweet Scent's special promotional puzzle for a shot at a sensational prize?
en: Hello! Would you like to play Sweet Scent's special promotional puzzle for a shot at a sensational prize?
ja: こんにちは! スイートセントの特別プロモーションパズルに挑戦して、豪華賞品のチャンスをつかみませんか?

key: Do you want to skip this tile puzzle?
en: Do you want to skip this tile puzzle?
ja: このタイルパズルをスキップしますか?

key: Excellent! All you have to do is arrange the tiles to form the proper picture. Rotate the tiles using the Ready Item key, and move them with the Action key.
en: Excellent! All you have to do is arrange the tiles to form the proper picture. Rotate the tiles using the Ready Item key, and move them with the Action key.
ja: 素晴らしい! タイルを並べ替えて、正しい絵を完成させるだけです。持ち物キーでタイルを回転させ、決定キーで動かしてください。

key: We have a winner!
en: We have a winner!
ja: 当選者です!

key: And for your prize, we present your very own Sweet Scent-sponsored Spritzee!
en: And for your prize, we present your very own Sweet Scent-sponsored Spritzee!
ja: 景品として、スイートセント協賛のシュシュプを差し上げます!

key: Well, take your time! This promotion won't end anytime soon!
en: Well, take your time! This promotion won't end anytime soon!
ja: ゆっくりどうぞ! このプロモーションはすぐには終わりませんので!

key: Oh? Any time!
en: Oh? Any time!
ja: あら? いつでもどうぞ!

key: Hello! Have you ever seen a spot of soil that looked rich and nutritious?
en: Hello! Have you ever seen a spot of soil that looked rich and nutritious?
ja: こんにちは! 栄養たっぷりに見える土を、見かけたことはありますか?

key: Because, well... I haven't.
en: Because, well... I haven't.
ja: というのも、その、わたしは見たことがなくて。

key: I don't think there are any places like that left within the city.
en: I don't think there are any places like that left within the city.
ja: この街には、もうそんな場所は残っていないと思います。

key: But I want to think, that maybe someday, there will be.
en: But I want to think, that maybe someday, there will be.
ja: でも、いつかまた、そんな場所ができるって信じたいんです。

key: So, here.
en: So, here.
ja: だから、これを。

key: If you ever find one, please use this. Help the plants there grow into great big trees!
en: If you ever find one, please use this. Help the plants there grow into great big trees!
ja: もしそういう場所を見つけたら、これを使ってください。そこの植物が、大きな木に育つ手助けをしてあげて!

key: If you ever find a Berry tree, be sure to take good care of it!
en: If you ever find a Berry tree, be sure to take good care of it!
ja: 木の実の木を見つけたら、必ず大切にしてくださいね!

key: Hello! Have you been to our garden?
en: Hello! Have you been to our garden?
ja: こんにちは! わたしたちの庭園に行かれたことはありますか?

key: We have all worked very hard on it as a community, and I'm very proud to say that it's now a wonderful area for everyone in the city to enjoy!
en: We have all worked very hard on it as a community, and I'm very proud to say that it's now a wonderful area for everyone in the city to enjoy!
ja: みんなで力を合わせて頑張ってきて、今では街のみんなが楽しめる素敵な場所になったこと、とても誇らしく思っています!

key: Please, if you're ever in the area, help out!
en: Please, if you're ever in the area, help out!
ja: もし近くに来たら、ぜひ手伝ってください!

key: If you use this, you can help the plants there grow into great big trees!
en: If you use this, you can help the plants there grow into great big trees!
ja: これを使えば、そこの植物が大きな木に育つ手助けができます!

key: And if you ever find a Berry tree, be sure to take good care of it!
en: And if you ever find a Berry tree, be sure to take good care of it!
ja: それと、木の実の木を見つけたら、必ず大切にしてくださいね!

key: Excuse me, have you seen a Budew wandering around anywhere?
en: Excuse me, have you seen a Budew wandering around anywhere?
ja: すみません、どこかでスボミーがうろついているのを見ませんでしたか?

key: Oh my, you did?
en: Oh my, you did?
ja: あら、見たんですか?

key: It fell into the Peridot Ward?!
en: It fell into the Peridot Ward?!
ja: ペリドット地区に落ちてしまったんですか?!

key: How could we be so careless?!
en: How could we be so careless?!
ja: なんて不注意だったんでしょう?!

key: Goodness, thank you so much for saving the little thing!
en: Goodness, thank you so much for saving the little thing!
ja: まあ、あの子を助けてくださって、本当にありがとうございます!

key: I've been worried sick ever since it disappeared.
en: I've been worried sick ever since it disappeared.
ja: いなくなってから、ずっと心配で仕方なかったんです。

key: It had developed a bad habit of running outside, but when it didn't come back...
en: It had developed a bad habit of running outside, but when it didn't come back...
ja: 外に走り出す悪い癖がついてしまっていたんですが、戻ってこなかった時は……

key: Well, never mind! You should do me a favor.
en: Well, never mind! You should do me a favor.
ja: まあ、それはいいんです! お願いを聞いてほしくて。

key: No, think of it more as a 'thank you'.
en: No, think of it more as a 'thank you'.
ja: いえ、「お礼」だと思ってください。

key: Please keep Budew, okay?
en: Please keep Budew, okay?
ja: スボミーを、あなたが飼ってあげてもらえませんか?

key: Clearly it's too restless to stay in a place like this anymore.
en: Clearly it's too restless to stay in a place like this anymore.
ja: こんな場所に留まるには、あきらかに落ち着きがなさすぎるので。

key: You can probably serve it better than we can.
en: You can probably serve it better than we can.
ja: わたしたちよりも、あなたの方がきっと、この子のためになると思うんです。

key: Hello! Have you seen the Lapis Community Garden?
en: Hello! Have you seen the Lapis Community Garden?
ja: こんにちは! ラピスのコミュニティガーデンをご覧になりましたか?

key: Just on the east side of 5th Street, Sweet Scent is proud to sponsor the community's effort in rebuilding our great city.
en: Just on the east side of 5th Street, Sweet Scent is proud to sponsor the community's effort in rebuilding our great city.
ja: 5番街のすぐ東側で、スイートセントは、この偉大な街の再建に向けたコミュニティの取り組みを、誇りを持って支援しています。

key: If you'd like to get in on business with the fastest- growing company, please consider joining our wonderful team!
en: If you'd like to get in on business with the fastest- growing company, please consider joining our wonderful team!
ja: 急成長中の会社と一緒に働きたい方は、ぜひわたしたちの素晴らしいチームに加わることをご検討ください!

key: We offer applications online, or from our brand-new company HQ at 9th and Saffron.
en: We offer applications online, or from our brand-new company HQ at 9th and Saffron.
ja: 応募は、オンラインまたは9番街とサフロンにある新しい本社から受け付けています。

key: By the way, how's that little Budew doing these days?
en: By the way, how's that little Budew doing these days?
ja: ところで、あの小さなスボミーは、最近どうしていますか?

key: Hmm...
en: Hmm...
ja: うーん……

key: Oh, you've still got the little one!
en: Oh, you've still got the little one!
ja: あら、まだあの子を飼っていらっしゃるんですね!

key: Fantastic.
en: Fantastic.
ja: 素晴らしいです。

key: You know, since you seem to care for this Pokémon so much, have you ever thought about spending more time with it?
en: You know, since you seem to care for this Pokémon so much, have you ever thought about spending more time with it?
ja: ねえ、そのポケモンをそんなに大切にされているようですけど、もっと一緒に時間を過ごすことを考えたことはありますか?

key: The next time someone asks you for a password, try telling them "budewit"!
en: The next time someone asks you for a password, try telling them "budewit"!
ja: 今度誰かにパスワードを聞かれたら、「budewit」って言ってみてください!

key: I'm sure you'll just love what happens!
en: I'm sure you'll just love what happens!
ja: きっと、起きることを気に入っていただけるはずです!

key: Care for some all Natural Gifts?
en: Care for some all Natural Gifts?
ja: 天然素材のギフトはいかがですか?

key: Quality Nectar sold here, imported straight from Alola! This delicacy will spruce up any routine!
en: Quality Nectar sold here, imported straight from Alola!  This delicacy will spruce up any routine!
ja: 上質なみつ、アローラから直輸入したものをこちらで販売中! この逸品が、日々をきっと彩ってくれます!

key: Quality import Nectar and assorted Seeds are sold here! Don't miss this chance!
en: Quality import Nectar and assorted Seeds are sold here! Don't miss this chance!
ja: 上質な輸入みつと各種たねを販売中! このチャンスをお見逃しなく!

key: Gosh, don't they have any Herbal Extract in stock...?
en: Gosh, don't they have any Herbal Extract in stock...?
ja: ああ、やくそうエキス、在庫ないのかしら……?

key: I was really hoping I could pick one up for my allergies.
en: I was really hoping I could pick one up for my allergies.
ja: アレルギー対策に買いたかったんだけど。

key: Hey. You.
en: Hey. You.
ja: ちょっと。あんた。

key: Yeah, you. You seem chill. Are you chill?
en: Yeah, you. You seem chill. Are you chill?
ja: そうそう、あんただよ。落ち着いてる感じだね。落ち着いてる?

key: I knew it.
en: I knew it.
ja: だと思った。

key: Nice try. A person who's not chill would never say that.
en: Nice try. A person who's not chill would never say that.
ja: いい返しだね。落ち着いてない人は絶対そんなこと言わないから。

key: Look, my name's Salleigh, and I need your help with something.
en: Look, my name's Salleigh, and I need your help with something.
ja: あのさ、あたしの名前はサレイ。ちょっと手伝ってほしいことがあるの。

key: We got this big commission recently...
en: We got this big commission recently...
ja: 最近、大きな依頼が来てさ……

key: From a uhhhhhhh, "Laura Belrose".
en: From a uhhhhhhh, "Laura Belrose".
ja: その、えーっと、「ローラ・ベルローズ」って人から。

key: With a name like that, I swear she should be the one working in this place,
en: With a name like that, I swear she should be the one working in this place,
ja: あんな名前してるんだから、この店で働くべきなのはあの人の方だと思うんだけど、

key: But she's not. I am.
en: But she's not. I am.
ja: でも違う。あたしなの。

key: And here's the tea-- have you noticed how all of the other employees have the exact same hair and dress?
en: And here's the tea-- have you noticed how all of the other employees have the exact same hair and dress?
ja: それでゴシップなんだけど――他の従業員が全員同じ髪型と服装してるの、気づいた?

key: It's creepy, isn't it?
en: It's creepy, isn't it?
ja: 不気味でしょ?

key: It's like they just give up their humanity to become flower shop girls.
en: It's like they just give up their humanity to become flower shop girls.
ja: まるで、花屋の店員になるために人間性を放棄したみたいなの。

key: It's been skeeving me out ever since I got here.
en: It's been skeeving me out ever since I got here.
ja: ここに来てからずっと、気持ち悪くて仕方ないんだ。

key: They wanted me to dye my hair too, and wear the uniform.
en: They wanted me to dye my hair too, and wear the uniform.
ja: あたしにも髪を染めて、制服を着ろって言ってきたの。

key: I fell asleep on break ONE time and when I woke up, they'd already styled it this way.
en: I fell asleep on break ONE time and when I woke up, they'd already styled it this way.
ja: 休憩中に一回寝ちゃったら、起きた時にはもうこの髪型にされてたんだから。

key: So I said, "No! I can do this job just as good as any of you without conforming to your dress code!"
en: So I said, "No! I can do this job just as good as any of you without conforming to your dress code!"
ja: だから言ってやったの、「嫌! あんたたちのドレスコードに従わなくたって、同じくらいちゃんと仕事できるし!」って。

key: And now my boss has it out for me, and he assigned me this whole commission to handle all by myself, and if I don't finish it in time--
en: And now my boss has it out for me, and he assigned me this whole commission to handle all by myself, and if I don't finish it in time--
ja: それで今、上司に目をつけられて、この依頼を一人で丸ごと押し付けられてて、間に合わなかったら――

key: I-- I don't know how I'll be able to go on living.
en: I-- I don't know how I'll be able to go on living.
ja: あたし――どうやって生きていけばいいかわからない。

key: I really need this job, but if I don't do this perfectly...
en: I really need this job, but if I don't do this perfectly...
ja: この仕事、本当に必要なんだけど、完璧にやらないと……

key: They're going to dye my hair green.
en: They're going to dye my hair green.
ja: 髪を緑に染められちゃう。

key: Can you believe it?! Green!
en: Can you believe it?! Green!
ja: 信じられる?! 緑だよ!

key: I've never met a single person who had green hair and WASN'T fucked up somehow.
en: I've never met a single person who had green hair and WASN'T fucked up somehow.
ja: 緑髪でどこかおかしくない人なんて、一人も見たことないんだけど。

key: The client asked for us to make a perfume from a handful of Pokémon.
en: The client asked for us to make a perfume from a handful of Pokémon.
ja: クライアントが、何種類かのポケモンから香水を作ってほしいって頼んできたの。

key: Specifically, ones that have flowers somewhere on their body.
en: Specifically, ones that have flowers somewhere on their body.
ja: 具体的には、体のどこかに花があるポケモンね。

key: But I signed up here to handle flowers-- NOT Pokémon.
en: But I signed up here to handle flowers-- NOT Pokémon.
ja: でも、あたしがここで働くことにしたのは花を扱うためであって――ポケモンじゃない。

key: I'm useless with those.
en: I'm useless with those.
ja: ポケモン相手だと、あたし全然使えないの。

key: MORE than useless.
en: MORE than useless.
ja: 使えない以上に、だめ。

key: One time I tried to catch a Caterpie.
en: One time I tried to catch a Caterpie.
ja: 一回、キャタピーを捕まえようとしたことがあって。

key: I ended up String Shot and suspended upside down for a week.
en: I ended up String Shot and suspended upside down for a week.
ja: いとをはかれて、一週間逆さつりにされたんだから。

key: You have to help me.
en: You have to help me.
ja: 助けてくれなきゃ困る。

key: SALLEIGH: I'm counting on you. My livelihood is at stake here.
en: SALLEIGH: I'm counting on you. My livelihood is at stake here.
ja: サレイ: あんたが頼りなの。あたしの生活がかかってるんだから。

key: We just need Pokémon species that have a flower somewhere on their body.
en: We just need Pokémon species that have a flower somewhere on their body.
ja: 体のどこかに花があるポケモンの種類が、必要なだけなの。

key: Three in total! If you have any, please help!
en: Three in total! If you have any, please help!
ja: 全部で3種類! 持ってたら、助けて!

key: Two more! Please rescue me!
en: Two more! Please rescue me!
ja: あと2種類! 助けてよ!

key: Only one more! If you don't save me, I'm gonna be green for the rest of my days!
en: Only one more! If you don't save me, I'm gonna be green for the rest of my days!
ja: あと1種類だけ! 助けてくれないと、一生緑髪になっちゃう!

key: SALLEIGH: Please.
en: SALLEIGH: Please.
ja: サレイ: お願い。

key: Please, I'm begging you.
en: Please, I'm begging you.
ja: お願い、頼むから。

key: Anything with a flower.
en: Anything with a flower.
ja: 花がついてれば何でもいいの。

key: Help.
en: Help.
ja: 助けて。

key: SALLEIGH: That's-- That's it! That's all we need!
en: SALLEIGH: That's-- That's it! That's all we need!
ja: サレイ: それで――それで全部! これで全部そろった!

key: We've done it!
en: We've done it!
ja: やったよ!

key: I won't look like a cucumber!
en: I won't look like a cucumber!
ja: キュウリみたいな見た目にならずに済む!

key: Perfume mixing is easy-- check me out.
en: Perfume mixing is easy-- check me out.
ja: 香水作りなんて簡単――見ててよ。

key: SALLEIGH: Hit 'em with a little bit of Bang!
en: SALLEIGH: Hit 'em with a little bit of Bang!
ja: サレイ: ちょっとバン!ってやって!

key: Hit 'em with a little bit of Pow!
en: Hit 'em with a little bit of Pow!
ja: ちょっとポウ!ってやる!

key: Mix it up like a Maractus, and...
en: Mix it up like a Maractus, and...
ja: サボネアみたいに混ぜて、そして……

key: SALLEIGH: Shika-shake-a-wowowow!
en: SALLEIGH: Shika-shake-a-wowowow!
ja: サレイ: シカ・シェイカ・ワウワウワウ!

key: SALLEIGH: Presto-kapowleen!
en: SALLEIGH: Presto-kapowleen!
ja: サレイ: プレスト・カパウリーン!

key: Now my hair need not be green!
en: Now my hair need not be green!
ja: もう、髪を緑にされずに済む!

key: You really got me out of a pickle-colored pickle there!
en: You really got me out of a pickle-colored pickle there!
ja: ピクルス色のピンチから、本当に救ってくれたね!

key: Take this for your trouble!
en: Take this for your trouble!
ja: お礼にこれを受け取って!

key: SALLEIGH: And hey, if anyone asks you about your involvement here...
en: SALLEIGH: And hey, if anyone asks you about your involvement here...
ja: サレイ: それと、もし誰かにここでのあんたの関わりについて聞かれたら……

key: Tell them NOTHING.
en: Tell them NOTHING.
ja: 何も言わないで。

key: No, better yet... If anyone asks you something strange, tell them "freerainbow".
en: No, better yet... If anyone asks you something strange, tell them "freerainbow".
ja: ううん、それより……誰かに変なこと聞かれたら、「freerainbow」って言ってやって。

key: That'll get them off my case for sure.
en: That'll get them off my case for sure.
ja: それで絶対、あたしから手を引かせられるから。

key: I'm going to go fill my boss's desk with chewed bubblegum now.
en: I'm going to go fill my boss's desk with chewed bubblegum now.
ja: それじゃ、あたしは上司の机をかんだガムで埋め尽くしに行くね。

key: Cya!
en: Cya!
ja: またね!

key: SALLEIGH: This... This will work.
en: SALLEIGH: This... This will work.
ja: サレイ: これ……これでいけるはず。

key: Is this what hope feels like...?
en: Is this what hope feels like...?
ja: これが希望って感じなのかな……?

key: But we're not done yet!
en: But we're not done yet!
ja: でも、まだ終わってないよ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
